events.excerpt: Come along and enjoy exciting gaming afternoons at the Wasserturm Library! It offers two gaming sessions every week for teenagers, families and friends. Whether in small groups or with the whole family – there’s something for everyone here.

events.excerpt: From 12 November 2026, Lucia will once again be leaving her trail of light at the MACHmit! Museum. She invites everyone to join her in her Lucia House. By candlelight and with the crackling of the fire, you can let her inspire you.

events.name: Who, How, What at Christmas
events.excerpt: As always, the two troll girls, Frieda and Mey, are hibernating. But this year, they’re woken up by Hörnchen: ‘Christmas is just round the corner and I desperately need THE present.’ ‘Who on earth is Christmas, and what might he need?’…

events.name: The Tridiculous ABC
events.excerpt: Energy, music, artistry, and plenty of humor—that’s Tridiculous.

events.name: Stargazer
events.excerpt: The universe is full of wonders: Countless stars, star clusters, nebulae, and galaxies are waiting to be discovered. Using a telescope, you’ll set out together to explore these fascinating celestial objects.

events.name: LITTLE LORD FAUNTLEROY – Musical
events.excerpt: The ideal way to get into the Christmas spirit! Experience the classic as a touching world premiere live at BlueMax Theater Berlin. A holiday highlight for the whole family. Nov 13 – Dec 30, 2026 – get tickets now!

events.name: LITTLE LORD FAUNTLEROY – Musical
events.excerpt: The ideal way to get into the Christmas spirit! Experience the classic as a touching world premiere live at BlueMax Theater Berlin. A holiday highlight for the whole family. Nov 13 – Dec 30, 2026 – get tickets now!

events.name: The Little Lord - The Musical
events.excerpt: With “Little Lord Fauntleroy,” one of the greatest Christmas traditions of all time will finally celebrate its spectacular world premiere in the winter of 2026 as a heartwarming musical for the whole family.

events.name: Interactive Concert. “At the Zoo: Roar-toot”
events.excerpt: These interactive concerts combine music, dance, and movement into a vibrant experience. Four times a season, music lovers of all ages can visit the Berlin Philharmonic and explore the different timbres of string, wind, and percussion…

events.name: Open Day at the Wolfdietrich Schnurre Library
events.excerpt: You’re warmly invited to come and explore the library!

events.name: Open Day at the Wolfdietrich Schnurre Library!
events.excerpt: You’re warmly invited to come and explore the library!

events.name: Bauhaus Music 2026 Workshop: Kandinsky Synths
events.excerpt: Drawing on Wassily Kandinsky’s theory of colour and form, participants will make colours audible using mini-synthesisers they have built themselves.

events.name: Georg the Green – an environmental awareness show for children with Georg Weisfeld
events.excerpt: Georg the Green is coming to make everyone laugh. And he can only do that with the children’s help. It’s a medley of songs, juggling, magic, mime and clowning.

events.name: STOP OVER 5 – For Young Ears
events.excerpt: The exploratorium berlin is presenting ZENTRUM UNDER CONSTRUCTION BERLIN – STOP OVER 5 – For Young Ears – “Oh, that too! A concert of improvised music for children – with children”

events.name: Straw craft workshop
events.excerpt: Straw can be turned into something truly special! With a touch of creativity and a sense of fun, you can create beautiful little works of art from natural materials.

events.name: Opening of the Empathy Museum
events.excerpt: At the Empathy Museum, a collection of life stories is growing – personal accounts from neighbours. Others listen to them later via a digital platform. In this way, people who would otherwise never have met come together.

events.name: SpielWELTEN
events.excerpt: Together with KATE e. V., the FEZ raises important questions about diversity, children’s rights, global justice and a future worth living in: in a child-friendly and creative way, with plenty of opportunities for children to get involved…

events.name: Picture Book Cinema: Play, Imagination, and Family Magic
events.excerpt: The picture books ‘Der beste Babysitter bin ich’ by Johanna von Horn and Charlotte Ramel, ‘Mamas Zaubertuch’ by Chimamanda Ngozi Adiche and ‘Oma-Emma-Mama’ by Lorenz Pauli and Kathrin Schärer will be read.

events.name: Workshop with Lucie Lučanská: The Book of the Five Senses
events.excerpt: The book is designed to help children focus better on individual sensory impressions and engage with things attentively and deeply.

events.name: Craft workshop: Stamping with Meike Dölp
events.excerpt: You’ll stamp everything to smithereens: letters, tickets, important documents – but first, you’ll make your own stylish stamp.

events.name: Crown on, you are wonderful!
events.excerpt: Put on your crown – you’re wonderful! Together with ZULA, children and their families discover what makes them unique through interactive picture book readings.

events.name: Forum, Flashes of Colour, Fantasy
events.excerpt: Imagine this: right in the heart of the city there is a place where people of all ages come together to dream, reflect and ask questions.

events.name: From selfie to emperor: self-portraits
events.excerpt: Act like the Roman emperors! Dream yourself into foreign worlds! Decipher secret messages! Take a look at ancient buildings! Children and their adult companions explore the museums on their own and with a task.

events.name: Pappelapapp
events.excerpt: Cardboard, cardboard – cardboard this, cardboard that. A cardboard box is just a cardboard box, isn’t it? With just a little imagination, any transport box can be transformed into a cardboard tiger, a cardboard dragon, a little cardboard…

events.name: Picture Book Cinema: Over Here, Over There, and Over the Wall
events.excerpt: Come and listen to a reading of the picture books “Der erste Schritt” by Pija Lindenbaum as well as ”Die Mauer. Eine Parabel” by Giancarlo Macri und Carolina Zanotti illustrated by Sacco & Valleriano.

events.name: Susel und Knistas Geräuschwerkstatt
events.excerpt: Whistling winds, clattering spoons, rustling bags: in ‘Susel & Knista’s Sound Workshop’, everyday sounds are transformed into music. An interactive concert for primary school-aged children to join in, discover and explore sound together.

events.name: 40th Berlin Children’s Circus Festival, Part II: Berlin’s children in the spotlight
events.excerpt: “Clear the ring!” for the city’s young up-and-coming performers. Breakdancers, dancers, clowns, jugglers and acrobats will thrill the audience with a fast-paced show full of humour and joie de vivre.

events.name: Disco son and demo what? How does democracy work?
events.excerpt: Come and listen to a reading of the classic picture books ‘Ich bin für mich‘ by Martin Baltscheit und Christine Schwarz as well as ‘Jetzt bestimme ich!‘ by Julie Zeh und Dunja Schnabel.

events.name: Coq Au Vin Family Theatre – Ala Labama’s Grand Magic Show
events.excerpt: The great Ala Labama is coming to town! Let yourself be whisked away into his magical world. Sensational feats of skill and breathtaking magic await you!

events.name: Fritz and Fridolin and the Seasons
events.excerpt: The two bear cubs, Fritz and Fridolin, are the very best of friends and even share the same birthday. They’ve just woken up from hibernation. Together with you and their animal friends, they’ll be exploring the seasons.

events.name: The Thief at the Circus
events.venue: Kinder und Familientheater Coq Au Vin (Neukölln)
events.excerpt: Detective Jonathan bursts into the middle of a chaotic circus performance! There’s a thief in the audience! Things have been stolen—and are still being stolen.

events.name: Around the World in 80 Days
events.excerpt: Max loves to read. Now a book written over 150 years ago has captivated him: In 80 Tagen um die Welt by Jules Verne, known in English as Around the World in 80 Days.

events.name: Art Sunday: Let your creativity run wild!
events.excerpt: This workshop focuses on creating collaborative compositions using a simple yet effective printing technique. Artistic prints are produced using rollers, palette knives, paper, pens, scissors, cloths, sponges, linocut inks and a simple…

events.name: Die guten Freunde – Theater auf dem Bügelbrett
events.excerpt: The animals in the forest don’t have much to eat in winter. Yet they are always willing to share with one another. And because each of them thinks not only of themselves but also of their friends, in the end everyone benefits.

events.name: Treasure box. Drop-In for families and children
events.excerpt: Who or what is close to your heart and has a special place in your treasure box? Cuddly toys, friends, family, neighbours, plants, pets, Lego toys, comic figures, favourite book or something completely different?

events.name: The Awakening of Osiris
events.venue: Haus Bastian – Zentrum für Kulturelle Bildung
events.excerpt: The ancient Egyptians believed that the god Osiris had conquered death and lived on eternally as ruler of the underworld. Osiris was also regarded as a god of fertility and was therefore responsible for the vegetation of the Nile Valley.

events.name: CIACCONNA CLOX: KLEINE GESCHICHTEN von TOLSTOI
events.excerpt: Leo Tolstoy, whose works rarely ran to fewer than a thousand pages, also wrote a few enchanting miniature stories for children – little gems of just ten lines or so.

events.name: So ist das Leben mit Erwachsenen
events.excerpt: Twenty-four people – some very young, others a little older – have worked together to illustrate and write a book. It features comics, poems, collages, stories and much more, all exploring how young children and teenagers perceive life…

events.name: Protective beings. Superpowers of nature. Drop-In
events.excerpt: The immersive panorama by artist Yorleny Cardozo Peña vividly illustrates the flora and Fauna of the Colombian mountain massif as well as guardian figures that are thousands of years old.

events.name: Ute Kahrmann – Rapunzel
events.excerpt: Fairy tales loosely based on the Brothers Grimm. For children aged 4 and over.

events.name: LICHTERKINDER Live - "Millions of Stars" Tour 2026
events.excerpt: Singing, dancing, and shining together: With the “Millions of Stars Tour 2026,” the LICHTERKINDER are bringing their popular interactive concert to the Uber Eats Music Hall.

events.name: The Big Children’s Rights Concert
events.excerpt: Honigkuchenpferde are Germany’s first pop band for the whole family. With modern songs about friendship, diversity, courage and the little adventures of everyday life, they delight children and adults alike.

events.name: Pinocchio
events.excerpt: Geppetto, an old carpenter, longs for a child. One evening, he carves a puppet out of a piece of wood—and suddenly it comes to life. Pinocchio is born.

events.name: Picture-Book Cinema: Memories don’t die
events.excerpt: The picture books “The Colour of Lemons” by Kenesha Sneed, “When Grandma got smaller and smaller” by Inka Pabst and Mehrdad Zaeri and “When the whole world…” by Joseph Coelho and Allison Colpys will be read.

events.name: “Things that aren’t” – The Art of Micha Ullman
events.excerpt: An interactive picture-book cinema for people aged 8 and over. Large-scale projected illustrations, lively storytelling and a group discussion offer a playful introduction to art and literature.

events.name: Bilingual Fairy Tale Days: German / Persian
events.excerpt: Come along on a magical journey into the world of Persian stories! During this bilingual storytelling session, traditional Persian fairy tales are told in Persian and translated into German.

events.name: Kamishibai Storytelling Theatre
events.excerpt: They have lots of exciting and funny stories in store for curious children – alternately in German – every 1st and 3rd Monday of the month – and also in several languages – every 2nd and 4th Monday of the month.

events.name: Torchlight tour for families at the Berlin Aquarium
events.excerpt: When the lights go out at the Berlin Aquarium, the adventure begins! Armed only with your own torch, you’ll make your way through every floor of the dark aquarium. Are those eyes glinting in the beam of your torch?

events.name: Book Box and Song Journey: A reading and music session for babies and their carers
NOTHING or Mr Käseweis Flies to the Moon
events.excerpt: Mr Käseweis is at his wits’ end. All this noise! Someone’s always playing football, listening to music or dancing! Why can’t NOTHING just happen for once?

events.name: Anja Tuckermann: Back Then on Rosenstraße
events.excerpt: Late February 1943. In the heart of Nazi Berlin, hundreds of women gather in front of a building on Rosenstraße – visible, determined and vocal. Most of them are not Jewish.

events.name: Die Drei von der Klangstelle
events.excerpt: With the ‘Drei von der Klangstelle’, nothing is quite like a normal concert. Sure, there are great songs to sing along to – but above all, there’s loads to discover!

events.name: Charcoal drawings
events.excerpt: Craft workshop as part of the exhibition ‘KUNSTKNALL – Girl Power in Art’.

events.name: Craft Stories – A Creative Afternoon for Children
events.excerpt: The Library at the Water Tower warmly invites children aged 3 to 8 to its new, free series of events, ‘Craft Stories’.

events.name: Bilingual Fairy Tale Days: German – Spanish
events.excerpt: As part of the Bilingual Fairy Tale Days, the Theater auf dem Bügelbrett is presenting a very special bilingual fairy tale reading!

events.name: Yakari – Friends for Life
events.excerpt: The popular children’s musical is once again on a major tour of Germany and is aimed specifically at families with children of nursery and primary school age.

events.name: kehrseiten
events.excerpt: Bizarre images often appear in (night)mares: they are like little riddles. In a strange way, they spin experiences further, sometimes taking on a life of their own, and often leave behind more questions than answers.

events.name: Oliver Grammel – Energy = magic²
events.excerpt: There are things between heaven and earth that are hard to explain – but Oliver Grammel can!

events.name: If you want to see a whale
events.excerpt: “If you want to see a whale, fix both eyes on the sea … and wait … and wait … and wait …” But just waiting can be quite boring and tiring.

events.name: Materials Lab – Kids’ Club: My Paper Animal I – Body & Shape
events.excerpt: A tiger, a crocodile or an animal that doesn’t even exist yet?

events.name: SPOOKY Charlottenburg at the Palast
events.excerpt: Experience SPOOKY Charlottenburg – the witty youth show with royal flair, inspired by Queen Luise. A show full of courage, excitement and friendship. From 19 November 2026 to 29 January 2027, only at the Friedrichstadt-Palast in Berlin!

events.name: SPOOKY Charlottenburg at the Palast
events.excerpt: Experience SPOOKY Charlottenburg – the witty youth show with royal flair, inspired by Queen Luise. A show full of courage, excitement and friendship. From 19 November 2026 to 29 January 2027, only at the Friedrichstadt-Palast in Berlin!

events.name: Fairy Tale Evening in the Yurt
events.excerpt: Under the tented roof of the yurt, Mongolian fairy tales come to life, offering a narrative gateway to the culture and way of life of Mongolia.

events.name: The Fairy-Tale Hut in Monbijou Park makes a guest appearance at the KulturTribüne Grünau
events.excerpt: The Märchenhütte in Monbijou Park is making a guest appearance at the KulturTribüne Grünau with a family show and fairy tales for adults.
